recipes.label: Order a sniper to go into hiding
recipes.startdescription:
To the dark. Our enemy won't be able to find us, or harm us. And when we choose to strike again, it will be with the advantage of surprise...

[A Hidden Ally will not be targeted by most Enemy offensive actions, and will also have their aspects increased until the next time they are used.]
recipes.description: Here we wait. Here we bristle with anticipation.

recipes.label: Consult with a Sniper?
recipes.startdescription: If the infantry and tanks are our hammers, these men are our scalpels. I can order them into a hiding place to increase their effectiveness.

recipes.label: Bury a Fallen Ally
recipes.startdescription: Their war is over, but ours isn't. If we have time to spare, we could bury them properly. [You will gain a memory from this.]
recipes.description: They Fought, and now they rest in a proper grave. I think about them briefly, and move on.

recipes.label: Refresh an ally with Provisions?
recipes.startdescription: If I have extra provisions to spare, I can give them to my exhuasted allies to get them back in the fight sooner.
